CheckTitle: RDS instance has high availability (Primary/Standby) enabled
Description: **Huawei Cloud Relational Database Service (RDS)** instances are deployed in **Primary/Standby (HA)** mode across availability zones to maintain database **availability** during hardware or AZ failures.
Risk: Single-node RDS instances lack automated standby failover, creating a single point of failure that can cause extended service outages.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the **Huawei Cloud console**.
2. Navigate to **Relational Database Service (RDS)** > **Instances**.
3. Select the single-node DB instance and choose **More** > **Change Type to Primary/Standby**.
4. Select a standby AZ and confirm the change.

Recommendation.Text: Deploy production RDS instances in **Primary/Standby** mode across different availability zones.
